    left:0;

CSS

Apne <style> ke end mein ye add karo.

CSS
/*================ FOOD CARDS =================*/

.category-title{
    color:#fff;
    font-size:38px;
    margin:60px 0 30px;
    font-weight:700;
}

.food-card{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:15px;
    padding:20px;
    position:relative;
    text-align:center;
    transition:.4s;
    box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
}

.food-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-10px);
}

.discount{
    position:absolute;
    left:15px;
    top:15px;
    background:red;
    color:#fff;
    padding:5px 10px;
    border-radius:5px;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
}

.food-img{
    width:150px;
    height:150px;
    object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:50%;
    margin:30px auto 15px;
    display:block;
}

.food-card h4{
    font-size:24px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#222;
}

.price{
    margin:15px 0;
}

.price span{
    background:#ff0066;
    color:#fff;
    padding:8px 15px;
    border-radius:20px;
    font-weight:600;
}

.price del{
    color:#888;
    margin-left:10px;
}

.food-card button{
    border:none;
    background:#ffc107;
    color:#000;
    padding:10px 25px;
    border-radius:8px;
    font-weight:600;
    transition:.3s;
}

.food-card button:hover{
    background:#cda45e;
    color:#fff;
}
